en.title: Final Fantasy XIV Evercold Delayed Four Weeks, New Release Date Set
en.summary: The highly anticipated Final Fantasy XIV: Evercold expansion has seen a slight delay, pushing its launch back by a month. New details and a stunning cinematic trailer were unveiled at the Japan Fan Fest.
en.body:
The next major chapter for **Final Fantasy XIV**, titled **Evercold**, has been slightly delayed, shifting its release from January 2027 to February 23, 2027. Early access for the expansion will now begin on February 19, 2027. This adjustment, a mere four weeks from the originally announced timeframe, was revealed during the **FFXIV** Japan Fan Fest keynote. The announcement was accompanied by the premiere of the expansion's full opening cinematic, offering fans a tantalizing glimpse into the world and narrative that awaits them.

This delay comes after **Evercold** was first revealed at the North American Fan Fest in April of this year. While any delay can be a point of contention for eager players, director and producer **Naoki Yoshida** presented a wealth of new information alongside the revised date. He detailed the ongoing narrative direction for **Final Fantasy XIV** as it moves into its 8.0 version, alongside fundamental gameplay changes designed to evolve the critically acclaimed MMORPG. Pre-orders for **Evercold** are set to open on November 4, 2026, promising bonus items that will be revealed later during the Fan Fest festivities. The event also provided a look at the second new Job coming with the expansion: **Zephyr**, a ranged DPS class that wields a crossbow and commands an avian companion for support.

## A Glimpse into Evercold's World

The **Evercold** expansion promises to deliver a significant amount of new content beyond its central storyline and a brand-new world to explore. Fans can anticipate the return of crossover raid series, including collaborations with **Neon Genesis Evangelion** and **Final Fantasy VII**. Furthermore, a new Tank Job named **Bastion** will be introduced, adding another strategic layer to party compositions. The unveiling of the full cinematic trailer at the Japan Fan Fest has only amplified the community's excitement and speculation about the narrative threads that will be woven into this new expansion. The presentation by **Naoki Yoshida** also touched upon the fundamental gameplay changes that will accompany the launch of **Evercold**, indicating a significant evolution for the game's mechanics as it enters this new era.

## Community Eager for the Extended Wait

While the four-week delay for **Final Fantasy XIV: Evercold** might feel like a long time for dedicated players, the community's reaction has largely been understanding. The **FFXIV** fanbase has come to appreciate Square Enix's commitment to delivering polished and complete experiences, a philosophy that has served the MMORPG exceptionally well since its relaunch as **A Realm Reborn**. The detailed reveals at Fan Fest, including the stunning new cinematic and the introduction of the **Zephyr** Job, have kept spirits high. Players understand that this minor extension ensures the quality they've come to expect from one of the most successful MMORPGs currently available. The anticipation for **Evercold** remains incredibly strong, with discussions already buzzing about the potential lore implications of the **Evangelion** and **Final Fantasy VII** raid series.

## What's Next

With pre-orders opening on November 4, 2026, players will soon be able to secure their copy of **Final Fantasy XIV: Evercold** and its associated bonus items. The **FFXIV** Japan Fan Fest will continue to reveal further details about the expansion's new features, story beats, and gameplay adjustments in the coming days, with the official launch date now confirmed for February 23, 2027 (February 19, 2027 for early access).

content_raw: Final Fantasy XIV Evercold was set to launch sometime in January 2027, which was announced as part of its initial reveal back in April this year during the North American FFXIV Fan Fest. However, this next expansion for the critically acclaimed MMORPG has been delayed – FFXIV Evercold's release date is now February 23, 2027 (and February 19, 2027 for early access). This was announced alongside the new, full trailer / intro cinematic for Evercold at FFXIV Fan Fest in Japan, and was said to only be a four-week delay. In typical FFXIV fashion, the third and final teaser trailer is the full opening cinematic for an expansion, and it kicked off the Japan Fan Fest keynote where director and producer Naoki Yoshida presented more details on new features, where the ongoing story is headed, and fundemental gameplay changes as FFXIV goes into version 8.0 alongside Evercold's launch. Pre-orders for Evercold open on November 4, 2026 and will come with several bonus items, which will be revealed later in the Fan Fest keynote - I will update this as they are shown. Additionally, we got a glimpse of the second new Job coming to his new expansion. It's a ranged DPS called Zephyr, which rocks a crossbow as their primary weapon and commands an avian companion to provide support. There's a lot coming to FFXIV Evercold in addition to a new world and main story including a Neon Genesis Evangelion crossover raid series , a Final Fantasy VII crossover raid series, a new Tank Job with Bastion, and much more. Be sure to check out my Dawntrail review as well to look back at the last expansion before heading into this new era for FFXIV.
